result.title: GeoThinker-$F$: Endogenous Predictive World Representations for Fast Spatial Intelligence
result.summary: Existing geometry-aware Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on external 3D encoders to provide structural priors, but executing these additional encoder paths at inference introduces substantial latency and computational overhead. We propose GeoThinker-$F$, an efficient framework that internalizes spatiotemporal perception by transforming causal MLLM hidden states into predictive latent world representations. Our key insight is that intermediate semantic representations contain sufficient information to predict useful representations of current geometry and future semantics, without requiring an exact reproduction of features from a dedicated 3D encoder. To realize this idea, GeoThinker-$F$ adopts a decoupled two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, the MLLM backbone is frozen while lightweight Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads learn from an offline 3D geometry expert and next-frame semantic targets. In the second stage, the external expert is removed, and the model is jointly optimized to generate and selectively integrate its self-predicted priors through a specialized Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion module. Extensive evaluations show that GeoThinker-$F$ eliminates runtime dependence on external 3D geometry encoders while maintaining competitive performance across diverse spatial intelligence benchmarks. It achieves up to a $3.6\times$ inference speedup, reducing latency from $1.45\,\mathrm{s}$ to $0.40\,\mathrm{s}$ while retaining strong spatial reasoning performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GeoThinker-F：用两阶段训练把 MLLM 隐状态转成预测性 latent 世界表示，第一阶段冻结主干、由轻量 LFP 头从离线 3D 几何专家和下一帧语义目标学习，第二阶段移除外部专家并用 SGT Fusion 选择性整合自预测先验，在空间智能基准上保持性能的同时去掉推理期外部 3D 编码器、获得最高约 3.6× 加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接落在「内部状态是否保留几何与任务必要信息并真正被使用」这条主线上，其用外部专家蒸馏 latent 先验、以预测目标塑造工作区、以及用自预测替代视觉旁路的做法，可供核查 latent 内容对答案的因果贡献与收益成本权衡。
